full_judgment: 4. The defendant Nos.1-4 contested the suit by filing a written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint contending, inter alia, that, under the President Order No.96 of 1972, the owners Gouranga Prashad Chowdhury filed L.R. Statement of 6.87 acres of land, unil Bikash Sen 1.25, Sukumar Biswas @ Sukamoy Biswas 1.24 and Mihir Kanti Das 1.24, Sachindra Nath 1.24, Pranab Das 9.65 in all 21.29 acres, and, the remaining 2.41 acres were surrendered to the Government. The further case, is that, the Government forfeited 7.40 acres of land, and, the tenants surrendered 2.81 acres of land, and, thus, the said forfeited, 7.40 acres of land, and, surrendered 2.81 acres belonged to the Government, and, was recorded in the Khas khatiaa of the Government.
